description: WAR AI - Your Personal AI Computer Agent for Windows

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SHARED,BACKEND,AGENT,FRONTEND" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev --workspace=shared" "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=windows-agent" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=windows-agent && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=windows-agent
